decision: The research-federated profile owns institutional onboarding and future A2A task delegation. Its coordinator identity is configured independently from H04 prototype networking and Arkiv wallet material.
reuse: P03-P08 catalog, science, jobs, evidence and review are required scientific foundations and remain in place.
F02 durable organization-owned registration, proof and A2A qualification are adapted into P09 while trust and research dispatch remain separate.
prototype_boundary: H04 operator-pinned loopback task/Arkiv routes remain prototype-only and are not P09-P11 acceptance evidence.
A public Agent Card, qualification pass or ENS text record cannot grant institution verification or research-task authority.
current_increment: With agent_onboarding_enabled and a dedicated Ed25519 coordinator identity, the organization agent API and onboarding worker can run without prototype_enabled or network_enabled. The API uses only the public coordinator key; the worker alone receives the matching private key.
remaining: Implement full P09 agent/capability/endpoint registry and scoped remote research delegation with official A2A transport.
Bind current ENS controller, service key and Arkiv wallet through P10 signed challenges and revocation checks.
Build P11 separate-wallet Arkiv task, claim, assignment and independent verification workflow.
Complete prerequisite gates and live external operator evidence before declaring federation accepted.
